lineage.v123_alias_change_declared: Scratch rank source only; static launcher asserts other 17 aliases equal V122 functional parent.

recipe_and_qualification.auditor_self_hash: Auditor hashes its source into audit_source_sha256; launcher checks against current file; both native/auditor are included in preflight tooling_sha256 and copied to receipt directory.
recipe_and_qualification.component_clock: 8 ns at 125 MHz or 10 ns at 100 MHz; loads XDC before synth_design.
recipe_and_qualification.core_run_and_report_recipe: Retained V120 recipe by derivation; auditor checks exact hashes against V120 handoff and parent receipts.
recipe_and_qualification.source_order: Launcher takes exact V120 handoff source_order; auditor compares it to the same handoff.
recipe_and_qualification.strict_qualification_flags: Auditor checks Verilator --assert -Wall without -Wno-fatal; executable CFLAGS -Werror; library-only top v97_forward; strict g++ adapter flags.

reproduction_limit: Checks concern source code and retained V122 evidence. No V123 native preflight was generated or executed; a later audit still depends on the workspace paths and retained parent evidence.
scope: Independent static review only; no preflight, native job, Docker, or Vivado action.
